name: World-State Transformations for Neuro-symbolic Interactive Storytelling
exact_model: arXiv:2605.24719 (method/system record, not a servable model)
access: public preprint (arXiv); evaluation used Llama 3 70B (open-weight) and Gemini 1.5 Flash (hosted)
license: Paper text CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; host models carry their own licenses.
context_tokens: not applicable (system record; depends on the host models used)
serving_path: Not servable; a neuro-symbolic interactive-storytelling architecture (PAYADOR lineage, same group as IVIE) where LLMs predict which pre-programmed world-state transformations to trigger from free-text player input.
game_research_use: Newest 2026 neuro-symbolic game-state work found in this pass; must be added to TRACE-RPG related work. It keeps world-state consistency by restricting LLMs to selecting authored transformations, evaluated with an 8-participant exploratory player-expression study in English and Spanish. It does not provide a transactional commit gate, trace-linked audit records, state-semantic replay, or any repair-operator comparison, so the paper's evidence gap is unchanged.
key_risk: Exploratory N=8 player study in a two-scenario setting; treating it as validated efficacy evidence for transformation-based control, or as covering TRACE-RPG's audit/repair territory, would misread its scope.
evidence_status: verified-primary from the arXiv abstract page as of 2026-08-21.
